messages.content: 曼聯的球員名單是什麼？

function.name: sports_team_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieve the top scorer of a sports team in a specific season. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team.description: The name of the sports team.

season.description: The season of interest, e.g. 2020-2021 NBA season.

league.description: The league the team is part of. Default is 'NBA'.

message.content: 我目前沒有即時存取曼聯完整球員名單的工具。請問您想查詢哪一個賽季（或年份）的球員名單？如果您只是想知道目前（2025/2026賽季）的大致名單，我可以提供一份常見的球員列表，供參考。

We have a tool to retrieve top scorer of a sports team in a specific season. But we need the entire roster. There's no tool for that. We can respond with a general answer or ask for clarification. We can also provide a list of current players. But we don't have a tool. We can answer manually. But we might not have up-to-date data. We can provide a general answer: "Here is the current squad list." But we might not have the exact list. We can say we don't have that data. But we can provide a typical answer: "The current squad includes ...". But we might not have the exact list. We can ask for clarification: "Which season's roster do you want?" Or "Do you want the current roster?" The user didn't specify a season. So we can ask for clarification.
